description: Wild species (F6b-1, ADR 070). Cross-references (prey ids, tile ids) are checked by FaunaSpecies on world build.

grass_tiles.description: tiles.json ids a grazer eating "grass" feeds on.

crop_tiles.description: tiles.json ids a grazer eating "crops" feeds on. Eating never damages the crop in F6b-1 (F6b-2 adds it).

eats.description: A grazer's foods: it eats when hungry while standing on one.

prey.description: A predator's prey species ids: a hungry predator kills one in reach and is fed.

steps_per_day.description: Behaviour steps (one tile move each) per calendar day.

hungry_after_days.description: Days after a meal at which the animal eats again.

starve_days.description: Days without a meal after which the animal dies.

adult_days.description: Age in days at which an animal may reproduce.

interval_days.description: Days between birth attempts of a fed adult.

radius.description: Chebyshev radius in which another adult of the species must stand.

cap.description: Population cap per map; births thin out as the count nears it.

sight.description: Chebyshev radius in which a hungry predator sees prey.
